items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, some people say that's why they think they killed Huey Long, too... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, in Louisiana.

ctx.x: Not that I know of, no. Up until Roosevelt, I think that opened their eyes quite a bit, opened their eyes quite a bit, because that man did quite a bit. People like President Abraham Lincoln, who was an abolitionist, that's why they killed him, get him out of the way.
Well, some people say that's why they think they killed Huey Long, too, because he was doing some of these programs --
